text_block_list.text: One day, a fan letter arrived for Rice Shower—

Rice Shower's happy expression suddenly
turns into one of deep unease...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice was worried that this person might
become unhappy just because they cheered for Rice—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice hated that idea so much...
I didn't even want to think about it, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother,
what should Rice do...?
choice_data_list: Take a look inside the fan letter

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister,
what should Rice do...?
choice_data_list: Take a look inside the fan letter

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...'Seeing you try your hardest in the race,
Rice-chan, gave me so much courage.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I see Rice-chan's smile..."
"...it always warms my heart."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice trying her best...
Rice's smile...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
There are people who will genuinely be happy about it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother.
I'm going to work harder and harder...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister.
I'll work harder and harder...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So that the people who support me
will be happy――

A flame of motivation
seemed to ignite in Rice Shower's eyes...!
